GADGET-style Regionalization for Gate 2

Source: R/gadget_regionalization.R
gadget_regionalization.Rd

Internal GADGET-style regionalization used by Gate 2 to identify regions of heterogeneous feature effects. The implementation uses centered ICE matrices as local effect curves and can jointly regionalize multiple features by minimizing the sum of within-region curve risks across the selected feature set. This mirrors the key GADGET idea: decompose global effects into interpretable regions when interactions make a single global curve too coarse.

Developed by Stefan Coors, Clara Vetter, Jonas Hauck, Bernd Bischl, Sven Hilbert.
